description: This file contains unit tests for the MenuItemAPI class in the OrangeHRM Mobile API module. It defines test cases to validate API responses under different scenarios related to menu item retrieval and handles not implemented methods for update and delete operations.

classes.name: MenuItemAPITest
classes.description: Unit test class for validating the MenuItemAPI endpoints in the OrangeHRM mobile module.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the getOne API method with scenarios where leave and timesheet periods are defined.

methods.name: testGetOne2
methods.description: Tests the getOne API method when leave and timesheet periods are not defined.

methods.name: testGetOne3
methods.description: Tests the getOne API method when the Time Module is disabled.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Ensures that the update method throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Checks that validation rules for update are not implemented.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures that the delete method throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Checks that validation rules for delete are not implemented.
